category_title: Disengaged students with off-task behaviors and social distractions
scenario_title: Small group science assignments and whole-class instruction
minimal_context: The student is working in a small group using an iPad to complete a science assignment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please work with your small group to complete the science assignment on your iPads.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns away from the assignment to talk to a peer) I'm just trying to understand what was going on with that thing earlier.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's do a quick check for understanding on the science material. Wiggle your fingers if you know what to do next.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shows a thumbs-down and does not wiggle their fingers)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, just keep trying to figure it out with your group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Opens a game on the iPad and looks over to copy off a friend's screen) If I can’t ‘Google’ the answer then I just don’t do it. I try to remember. I usually just wait for the answer.
